finding: POLE-SFT entropy AUC (0.643) improves over the ~0.62 general-model baseline: POLE-specific fine-tuning sharpens the schema-entropy->ambiguity signal, so the Bayesian scorer (3.3) is a usable secondary input to the Ambiguity Detector. Ablations remain flat (spread 0.005 <= 0.01): the scoring function is not the bottleneck (beam diversity is), so 3.3 may use the simplest scorer (normalised entropy) without loss.
